_doc: Blueprint §7 routing table, as configuration (Continuation Plan Stage 4). Hermes owns model SELECTION; agents ask for a slot, never a model id. Override any slot per run with WFACT_ROUTE_<SLOT>=anthropic:<model-id> (e.g. WFACT_ROUTE_INTAKE). Only slots actually read through packages/hermes/src/routing.ts are listed — the Phase 4 builder/evaluator split and Hermes-lite's own model are still chosen in their packages' modelClient.ts, a tracked gap (PROGRESS.md), not silently implied here. Prices re-verified 2026-09-28 against the Claude API pricing table; re-verify before relying on them.
